title: Macro-augmented sp500 cells — REAL macro panel (8/9 series, primary sources)
summary: Rebuilt the macro panel from FRED's upstream primary sources (Treasury nominal+TIPS curves, NY Fed EFFR, Yahoo VIX/USD) = 8 of 9 real daily series (BAMLH0A0HYM2 HY-OAS absent, no free source). Clean A/B (identical date_aligned windows, max_iter 1): the 8-series real panel beats both baseline and the 4-series proxy on the +20%/25d cell at EVERY K, and beats the baseline on +50%/50d. Real-only series (real yield, breakeven, curve slope, fed funds) are materially used. Found+fixed a feature-cache key collision (macro data content was not keyed). NOT yet a deployed-champion head-to-head.

cells.name: sp500_up_20pct_25d_dd10pct
